snippet.title: Pigeons Away | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Tap a pigeon, send it flying, clear the roof. Pigeons Away is a rooftop logic puzzle for iPhone, iPad and Android: 120 levels, a new twist every 10 levels with gulls, a cat and night shifts, and a new puzzle every day.

By Lianes8 Studio. https://lianes8studio.com/pigeons-away
